summary: Crestline Lending Solutions, LLC filed a Form 8-K reporting two routine financing events. First, on July 29, 2026, it amended its Loan Financing and Servicing Agreement, increasing the committed facility amount from $150 million to $350 million and reducing the uncommitted amount from $150 million to $50 million. Second, on July 24, 2026, it sold approximately 1.61 million units of its LLC interests at $19.63 per share, raising about $31.7 million via a capital call from investors under existing subscription agreements, exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D/S. These are ordinary credit facility amendments and capital calls, not special situations.
